title: Why “toxic movie release date” is trending in IN: 2,000+ searches, the facts (August 25, 2026)
description: “toxic movie release date” is trending in IN with 2,000+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from NDTV and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “toxic movie release date”
paragraphs: “toxic movie release date” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for IN (snapshot taken 2026-08-25T03:59:18+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from NDTV, Telegraph India, The Times of India. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Toxic Advance Booking Report: Yash Film Records Rs 24.27 Crore Gross Before Release” — NDTV
“Yash-starrer ‘Toxic’ earns over Rs 30 crore from advance bookings, trails ‘KGF: Chapter 2’” — Telegraph India
“'Toxic' advance booking surges as Mumbai adds 6 AM and 11.45 PM shows for Yash starrer amid massive deman” — The Times of India

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 24 Aug 2026 20:20:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-25T03:59:18+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-25T04:00:31+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
